title: VTA Services — Disable — payload
description: Request payload for vta/services/disable. Stops advertising a transport and republishes the log. For `didcomm` this schedules a drain rather than cutting delivery immediately — see `drainUntil` in the result.

drainTtlSecs.description: `didcomm` only: how long the unadvertised mediator keeps accepting delivery. Absent takes the agent's default. **0 means immediate teardown, and is only honoured when the request did not arrive through the mediator being torn down** — over a DIDComm-carried request the agent enforces a floor (1 hour), because cutting the mediator mid-request would discard the reply to the very task asking for it. A caller cannot rely on 0 being obeyed; read `drainUntil` in the result to learn what actually happened.
